hans.contract_flavor: A woodcutter named Hans, found at the wood-line. Villagers cry wolf. The old folk hide their faces.

mill.contract_flavor: The miller of Furt was found beside his wheel, broken like kindling. His prentice ran half-mad to the bailiff and would say only "it stood up — God, it stood up."

case_003.contract_flavor: Ernst Hübner, master tailor, found slumped against his fitting mirror. Expression serene. Three rings missing from his fingers. He measured twice and cut once — in cloth and in life.

case_004.contract_flavor: Willem Roth found forty feet from the treeline. Deep claw lacerations. Expression of pure terror. The snow remembers everything — and whatever did this was not in a hurry.

case_005.contract_flavor: Petra Holz, bookkeeper, found between two barrels in a locked cellar. No external wounds. Body contorted. She had the only key. Whatever was in there with her had been waiting long before she came down.

case_006.contract_flavor: Lord Aldric Fenn found dead at his desk. No wounds, no struggle. Glass of wine half-drunk. Body cold far beyond what the time of death allows — the room is warm but he is ice-cold to the touch.

case_007.contract_flavor: Bruno Stark, butcher's assistant, found partially consumed. Bite wounds unlike any tool — enormous radius, serrated edges. Whatever made them came back for more.

case_008.contract_flavor: Three women gone missing over two months. No bodies. All last seen smiling, following a charming man. All described the same man. That is not a natural happiness.

case_009.contract_flavor: Ingrid Farr found at a crossroads at dawn. Wounds from multiple attackers. She ran — wounds suggest pursuit over distance. At least three sets of tracks follow her. She almost made it to the road.

case_010.contract_flavor: A merchant buried three days ago has been seen walking through the lower quarter at night — by four separate witnesses. His grave is empty. This is not a resurrection.

case_011.contract_flavor: Pieter Maus found at the base of a tenement wall — four storeys below an open window. Falls happen. But Pieter was careful and sober, and the railing was solid. The claw marks on his shoulders are the thing.

case_012.contract_flavor: Four guild masters found dead at the table, as if in mid-conversation. No wounds. No poison in the cups. No evidence of anything except four men who simply stopped — together, at the same moment.
